title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 9: Jehu anointed king at Ramoth Gilead, the deaths of Joram and Ahaziah, and the end of Jezebel.

questions.text: What did Elisha tell one of the sons of the prophets to take in his hand to Ramoth Gilead?
questions.explanation: Elisha told him to put his belt on his waist, take a vial of oil in his hand and go to Ramoth Gilead.

answers.text: A horn of water
A vial of oil
A loaf of bread
A sealed letter

questions.text: What did Elisha say the man should do right after anointing Jehu?
questions.explanation: Elisha told him to pour the oil on Jehu's head, give Yahweh's word, then open the door, flee, and not wait.

answers.text: Stay and eat with the captains
Bring Jehu back to Elisha
Blow the trumpet in the city
Open the door, flee, and not wait

questions.text: What did the captains do when Jehu told them he had been anointed king?
questions.explanation: Each man took his cloak and put it under Jehu on the top of the stairs, blew the trumpet and said, 'Jehu is king.'

answers.text: They spread their cloaks under him on the stairs
They seized Jehu and bound him
They sent word to Joram in Jezreel
They tore their clothes and wept

questions.text: How did the watchman recognize that it was Jehu who was coming?
questions.explanation: The watchman said, 'The driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi, for he drives furiously.'

answers.text: He carried a red banner
He rode a white horse
He drove furiously
He came with a great army

questions.explanation: Jehu drew his bow with his full strength and struck Joram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart.

answers.text: He struck him with a sword at the gate
He threw him down from the watch tower
He struck him with an arrow from his bow
He had his servants stone him to death

questions.text: Where did Jehu tell Bidkar to throw Joram's body?
questions.explanation: Jehu told Bidkar to pick him up and throw him in the plot of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite.

answers.text: In the field of Naboth the Jezreelite
Into the pool of Samaria
Outside the gate of Jezreel
Into the Jordan River

questions.text: Where did Ahaziah king of Judah die after he was struck?
questions.explanation: Ahaziah was struck at the ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam; he fled to Megiddo and died there.

answers.text: Jezreel
Megiddo
Samaria
Ramoth Gilead

questions.text: What did Jezebel do when she heard that Jehu had come to Jezreel?
questions.explanation: Jezebel painted her eyes, adorned her head and looked out at the window.

answers.text: She fled from the city by night
She hid in an inner room
She sent her servants to fight him
She painted her eyes and adorned her head

questions.text: By what name did Jezebel call Jehu as he entered the gate?
questions.explanation: Jezebel said, 'Do you come in peace, Zimri, you murderer of your master?'

answers.text: Jeroboam
Zimri
Baasha
Bidkar

questions.text: What was found of Jezebel when they went to bury her?
questions.explanation: They went to bury her, but found no more of her than the skull, the feet and the palms of her hands.

answers.text: Her whole body, wrapped in her robes
Only her crown and her royal garments
Nothing at all, not even her bones
Only the skull, the feet and the palms of her hands
